segments.title: Chet Manscape Character Creation
segments.notes: Case and Kendelle meticulously sculpt the Chet Manscape avatar in Fallout 4's character creator, debating chin geometry, roguish handsomeness, and SPECIAL allocation before vault entry.

segments.title: Vault 111 Cryosleep & Wife's Murder
segments.notes: Chet survives nuclear detonation, witnesses spouse's execution by Institute agents, and escapes cryogenic suspension into 2287 Commonwealth.

segments.title: Sanctuary Restoration & Hatchet Rampage
segments.notes: Chet scraps entire neighborhood for shelf materials, adopts canine companion Bigito, and clears Corvega Assembly Plant using melee-focused Nerd Rage build.

segments.title: Minutemen General Promotion & Settlement Management
segments.notes: Chet earns General rank, retrieves locket for Abernathy farmers, plants corn/tato crops, and assigns settlers to water pumps.

segments.title: Abernathy Farm Defense & Farming Expansion
segments.notes: Chet defends farm from raiders, establishes supply lines, and maxes out food production while leveling past 20.

segments.title: Sign-off & Raid to dank sauce
segments.notes: Case ends four-hour Fallout 4 session, thanks subscribers, and raids GTA 5 roleplay streamer dank sauce with 'Chet axe raid' branding.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors four-hour Fallout 4 playthrough as Chet Manscape, sculpting avatar with Kendelle before embarking on melee-only Commonwealth rampage.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Co-pilots Chet's character creation, vetoing chin dimensions and hair choices while delivering signature walk-on banter.

characters.name: Chet Manscape
characters.notes: correspondent. Debuts as Fallout 4 protagonist with 10 STR/10 INT build, hatchet specialization, and interdimensional chat communion lore.

lore_notes.fact: Chet Manscape's canonical SPECIAL stats established: Strength 10, Perception 3, Endurance 2, Charisma 3, Intelligence 10, Agility 4, Luck 1 with Nerd Rage and Gun Nut perks prioritized.
Case establishes 'interdimensional vault' meta-narrative where he channels chat voices across realities into Chet's consciousness during gameplay.
Case confirms this is third restart of Fallout 4 playthrough, indicating recurring attachment to vault sequence and character creation phase.

episode_summary: Lead anchor Case Blackwell suspends standard news operations for a four-hour Fallout 4 immersion stream, debuting his Chet Manscape avatar — a 10-Strength/10-Intelligence melee scientist — who survives Vault 111, builds an obsessive shelf empire in Sanctuary, earns Minutemen General rank through hatchet diplomacy, and secures Abernathy Farm's food independence before signing off to raid a Grand Theft Auto V roleplay channel.
